review.notes: Full review. Gate passed at the head; depcheck 0 problems. Adversarial table of 23 rows with computed values. Sources: Wu (arXiv hep-th/0505003v1) and Garcia (arXiv 1604.03897v1) read, 10 locators checked; Quillen 1985, Mathai-Quillen 1986, Quillen 1988 and Berline-Getzler-Vergne resolve only to paywalled pages (uncertified, not verifiable). Blocking: 6.2 identity false at k = 0 by its own Check (P1); 2.6 Duhamel already in pinned Tau Ceti, proved by a scratch probe (P2); 1.2 restates Mathlib's GradedTensorProduct (P2); 3.2 Pfaffian restricted to Q-algebras (P2). P3: two padding declarations, false not-statable reason in docstring and description, a sign in 5.2's route, phi on odd forms, inexact locators, style and API-list items. Scratch probes elaborated with lake env lean; nothing in the worktree changed. The sources service created sources.toml in the package folder while fetching.
